newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended lower on Friday on long liquidation particularly in nearby months, weighed down by the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 80 to 240 yen lower, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 80 yen down at 14,420 yen per tonne.
The day's estimated trade volume was 25,350 lots.
The market was driven by technical factors amid thin buying interest as the market lacked fresh incentives, traders said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.74-1/2 per bushel at 0841 GMT, up from $2.74-1/4 at Thursday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.39-1/2 a bushel at 0842 GMT, up from $8.36 at Thursday's close.
